name: Source
summary: The file the canvas is pointed at, shown — with the range a passage carries highlighted, or a change’s file at its commit, at the line. It reads and never writes.
guidance: Source is the container the person is reading a file in. It follows the canvas passage and shows nothing else. Use your own file reader for file contents — it is faster and has no ceiling. Call `shown` only when the question is what the PERSON can see: it applies this container's own bounds (256 KB, first line numbered as it really is) and returns exactly what is on their screen, which is what to reference when you talk to them about a line. This module writes nothing: it cannot edit, save, create, rename or delete, and it points the canvas only when the person presses "Comment on this line" on a change’s file, which asks Review for a comment there. It follows a code location (context.location): to have it show a line of a change, set one.

mcp.about: What the Source container on the canvas is showing of a file, with its bounds and its line numbers.
